name: Fake
overview: Scripture warns against deceit and falsehood in various forms, emphasizing that God condemns those who raise false reports or bear unrighteous witness (Exodus 23:1). False prophets and false Christs are highlighted as dangerous deceivers who appear harmless but inwardly seek to mislead God’s people (Jeremiah 14:14; Matthew 7:15; Matthew 24:24). Jesus teaches that merely professing faith is insufficient for entering the kingdom of heaven; true obedience to the Father’s will is required, exposing the reality of fake Christians who claim allegiance but lack genuine commitment (Matthew 7:21). These passages collectively call believers to discernment and faithfulness, guarding against the deceit that can come from within the community of faith.
